playerListVector: Game+0x1baa8 (begin) / +0x1baac (end), 4-byte pointers, join order; REPENTOGON names it PlayerManager._playerList
playerIdentity: place in the player list; two players may share a controller, so the controller index only says whose input drives the player on the host
updateOrder: the game updates players in list order: 0 surprises on host and replica over 450 steps

leadingUpdate.source: captures after the update of the last listed player
leadingUpdate.replica: applies the snapshot with the update of the first listed player; the others are held in the body of the last snapshot

wire.playerRecord: controller u32 (0..7), position x/y and velocity x/y as float32, reserved u32 = 0
wire.section: last, after the enemy section; its first record repeats the header's body bit for bit
wire.spelling: one player on controller 0 is written only as version 1 or 2; version 3 otherwise

modules.secondPlayerCreation: the input module presses join (19) and menuConfirm (14) for a free controller in both games

closedLoop.path: client keyboard -> client input module -> INP1 -> host's second player simulated by the host's game -> WLD1 v3 -> client replica

candidatesFromRepentogonSignatures.note: found by byte signature in the J460 image, exactly one match each; none has been called or otherwise verified
